scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard Segre polarization and not general Segre--Veronese embeddings.
Only positive-dimensional projective-space factors are included; point factors are geometrically trivial.
The comparison is elementary after the standard degree and Euler formulas are juxtaposed, so an older unindexed or pedagogical source may contain the same classification.
title: Complete degree–Euler crossover for Segre products
